text: Habt ihr vergessen?Oder habt ihr nur Ihr Herz verhärtet?Diese Waffe ist...Der Versuch ist nötig, für eine Nation zu projizieren.Jeder Soldat, der für das Vaterland gestorben ist, sollte sich für ihren Versuch erfreuen.Du solltest sein, Power!Er ist leere und nichts.Der Krieg hat uns den Tod zu sehr zur Gewohnheit gemacht.Du Eberhaar, du hast den Respekt vor dem Leben verloren.Ganz gleich wie dieser Krieg endet, wir haben bereits verloren.

Move the bricks and steer across.Watch out for the tables on the ground.We see you.Yes, Raffia.Come with me.Sorry Bob, I'm half way done with the bricks.Help the Ecclestone team up and bring them to the east here.Get your helmet.My head machine is stuck.I took it off and left it somewhere.Put your hand up and put it on.Now.Keep working on dismantling those walls.There's still one more to go before your birth.

Fascinating.Come on, why don't we check out some of the local music?Thank you for tuning in to the Polymer Exhibition Hall Audio Guide.You are currently departing...This place really is like what the prediction indicated.A world that champions science, rationality, and order.Wouldn't you agree, Misma?I think you might like it here after.Think of it as a paid vacation.I won't deny the appeal, but since I'm here with you two, I'd call this a business trip at best.

Tomorrow?She never set the time.She's not planning to keep me waiting until the evening,is she?Or has she already gone in?Should I knock again?Someone must be in at thishour.Bonjour!Finally!Perhaps they didn't hear me knocking before?Err, hello?Right,I suppose I'll just let myself in.They could at least leave a light on for the customers.Hello?Anyone here?I think my...friend arrived before me.She's about this tall.

I have seen your drawings.You don't understand this place.Mistakes all over.And the people, they are uneasy.I feel it.Uneasy?Why do you think that?What should not be forgotten?The past, not the present.Voices, writings, and what has been asleep in this building?The echo stones are resonating with each other.The building could collapse at any minute!Watch your heads for falling debris!But not have come here.

Do I need a license or anything?Is it paid daily or monthly?Please form a line and wait for your turn, one at a time.Excuse me, miss, we're from the TV program Public Voices.We'd like to request an on-camera interview.What's going on?Why are you all crammed into this tiny room?Our girls on TV.That's why.TV?You've heard trucks passing along the old railway at night,or seen lights flickering back on at construction sites.

Buildings are what ground us.Remind us that we're not just a bunch of abstract thoughts bouncing around in our own heads.In the spaces they create, we become aware of our own existence.But here, I feel...exclusion.Let's go in first, shall we?It was night, and three of us sang.Breezy-weezy, Hanzo here's breezing.Etherico, come and look-see.Take note of these shapes.Triangles, rectangles, circles.Fused everywhere.

Stay where you are!I'll fight you!She's not listening to us at all.She's cold and scared.She must not be in her right mind.Do your best to calm her down.Just be sure not to hurt her.Understood.Maybe an incantation to keep her warm will help.Clear away from the ice.Find strength and true knowledge.Embrace the cold.So long lives this.This gives power to thee.Clear away from the ice.And embrace solitude.

Could you tell me where you last saw her?Sure, I...Excuse me, you're not from around here, are you?Your accents and those clothes give you away.Come with me, I know a warmer place to talk.The moment armies start to march, the world stands still.You fight or fall back, charge forward or run.And the lines between fiction and reality will blur, and soon he'll never wake up again.Soldiers crawl through trenches, roll in the mud, and charge to their deaths again

And beautiful.Thank you.The building will remember.It will remember every soul who labored to build it.This Echo Stone hasn't awakened yet.It may not offer true shelter like the others,but it's more than enough to serve as the finishing touch to our roof.Let me place it.It is so lovely.I can hardly bear to see it go.I dreamed about this ceremony last night.Everyone was sipping tea under the dome.Only I was drinking meat.

How foolishly simple you are.Yes, that's the look.Confusion, disbelief.It suits your kind perfectly.What a miserable blind existence, scurrying about in the dark.Unperceiving your limited, darkened minds blind to the spark of enlightenment.A creation forsaken from its inception.You could never wield true knowledge.Satiated your curiosity, realization finally dawned in your darkened mind.Your friend is gone.

Warum bist du überhaupt zurückgekommen?Wir haben schon genug Geister in diesem verdammten Schutzingraben.Du schlendest hier einfach durch und holst unsere Brüder.Du begreibst sie.Warum?Warum darfst du zurückkehren und sie bleiben tot?Willst du uns verhöhnen?Der Tod verspottet nicht, und er kann auch nicht aufhören zurückzukehren.Er ist ebenso machtlos, wie jeder andere Soldat seinen Dienst zu erfüllen.

What's that formation?It's written on the banner,The history of the deceased.In order to commemorate those who have left the country.The sacrifices of one generation fuel the achievements of the next.Even if it takes many generations to get there, those dreams may still come true.That's right.But don't be too serious.Today is a good day.Let's play some music.Sounds good to me.When did you change into a cannon?

Who are you?I didn't see you during the registration.Can you speak, sir?Looks nothing like the usual symptoms.A mutation, perhaps?Hold on, hold on!Would anyone care to explain this?What infected?Infected by what?Oh my!I thought it was just a silly game!I knew there was something wrong with her the moment she came on board.All that shouting and running about.And look, she's awfully pale too.No, no, it wasn't me!

What do we do?We have to take them down.All at once.All at once?How?Throw them into a room and leave the rest to those.I noticed them when we entered too.Explosives, I presume.Yes, Piros mentioned having seized them from a militia camp.Sounds like a plan, but how do we draw them close enough?This isn't a plan, this is madness.Do you seriously believe they'll simply staunter into a building as if it were some kind of concert?

Idealism does often come hand in hand with impracticality.Still, it's admirable to stand firm in your beliefs.Impractical or not, I respect it.It's no difference to me.This is only a job.Deliver 13 carriages and our passengers from one point to another safely.That's it.13 carriages?Are you sure?Seems unusual to choose an unlucky number for a train.I meant including the locomotive.Rolling stock then?

These murals have nearly faded away.Nonetheless, it appears we can rule out a biblical scene, nor does it appear to connectwith any significant Greco-Roman mythology.Perhaps there's some metaphor hidden in the narrative of these paintings.And if we can figure it out, we will find our way to the secret chamber.The problem is, there are so many murals.Where do we begin?They will help to express how you stand, move around, and exhibit feelings.

Close your eyes.Keep your breath steady and look into the darkness.Search for the light.I see it.Only a soft glow.But it's there.Take it.How?Do I make it come to me?Or should I go towards it?I...I think you meant to say, I've been looking all over for you, and here you are napping like a pamper cat.You certainly know how to enjoy yourself, don't you?Abandoning me to take a dose in this cushy parlor.

of exposition on the die of Babylon, beginning with its origins, as a secret relic createdby an Aztec priest, imprisoned by the Conquistadores.I don't know if that's going to do much, hermana.I'm beginning to think we'll never figure out what you're trying to say with thisnovel.And, well...and this isn't your fault.Ay, Dios.Just tell her, María.We're going back to Buenos Aires.We've both found amazing new ways to channel our inner poetry

Last and most important rule, don't be late.Work starts at 8 a.m.sharp,even one minute later and you'll be penalized.No exceptions, no excuses.What's that falling from up there?You down there, move it, quick!Everyone from under the dome,we need to check the joints.See that?How the concrete follows the texture of the echo stones?How it fills every crevice.They're becoming one.slowly steadily a true unification hold it steady let the concrete set at its own

Someone has to do something.I should have done this a long time ago.No.No need to speculate on how the past could have gone.There's an excellent opportunity.Right here and now.Everything inside the toy box changes with observation.It faithfully recreates my every thought, perception and idea.Turns out, there was no wall around the door after all.Back where I started.Not bad.But, it's clear you've made your decision.

I swore to protect and help.Yeah, they're just little...In all moments.I will remember your names.Our ally is the truth.I'm a fan of my work, I take it.There's strength in restraint.But me, I handle the pain.Restraint is part of me, I handle it.Stop it!A sacred charge.Please, stop this violence.A necessary counterattack.Don't touch my back!There's strength in restraint.A sacred charge.I handle the pain.

I weave the gown with thorns.You shall repay with sacrifice of wounds.Gone.Have we won?Seems like that might have been the ticket.The air feels a bit lighter now, don't you think?I'm concerned that might have something to do with the building collapsing around us.Everyone, onto the branches, please.I'll bring us down safely.No need to panic.That's just the architect beginning her work.All units, gather at the entrance.

Was it you who shot these men?Do you know who they are?You must have something more to say.Why bother showing yourself otherwise?The assassination in Manpei has been a serious blow to our global efforts.Many nations have withdrawn from our peace talks in response.Did we lose anyone?No.Our investigators on the scene confirmed they heard just a single gunshot at the time.We do have a confirmed sighting of the shooter.

I'm not sure you'd be able to read any of them.What does this mean?Oh, that?You know, I got this part from the Panjayuan antique market.It's not a genuine antique, but the craftsmanship is quite excellent.These characters here mean microwave safe.Funny enough, microwave ovens were not that popular when I got it.Speaking of Panjia Yuan, you can't find a flea market as big or as fun anywhere else.If you're ever looking for antiques and collectibles, it should be your first stop.

One day I'll die searching for treasure.But before then, I'll live as I see fit.I don't plan on wasting away my days in fear.The ending may be written,but that doesn't mean I want to follow the story world for world.That's what I told Cici as we were driving to her place.And now, looking back, maybe that's when it all began.So good!This gratin is the best!How'd you get so much flavor out of a simple potato?

people remember, celebrate, and reunite with their departed loved ones.And I have truly been moved by it.Now, please join me in raising a toast to all those past and to all who yet live.Let the party begin!He seems on edge.Did something happen?I should follow him.You didn't say you'd be here.I couldn't help but worry about you after I gave you that list.Huh.You can't even protect yourself.Why are you worrying about anyone else?

Not just for spinning wheels,but for animals, fathers and sons, mothers and daughters.Sure, you deserve a moment of quiet, savior.Forget about the mess out there.Take a break.Don't rest for too long, though.The Greyhound's on her way back with your hat.If you're not awake by the time she arrives, there's no telling what she'll do.

But every one of us was confident that a journey of this magnitude would pay offwith very many ancient secrets.When the sun dawned, we saw the lichen that grows all over the Aicho Islands.Crimson, green, ochre, even the landling couldn't pale those colors.That was when we realized that rocks can move too.I can't help but recall when the famous Guvernorin returned with a full and bountiful load.We celebrated the harvest very amazingly.

If the devoted journey let their songs unite.Um, hello?Can you hear me?Your topic, your research, your dream is a chance of a lifetime.But, we've never entered the ruins.The closest we came was in its periphery, but the weather was too severe.We had to turn back.But, but if Ma Tu is right, we'll make it this time.And by we, you mean-Well if it's possible, would you mind taking me with you?You see, I could be in danger waiting here by myself.

Hmm, but there's no volcano here.So stinky.The sulfur dioxide in lava does have a strong smell, but it's not as sour and smelly as this.Besides, the last time my team and I were here, these towers weren't.That was less than a hundred days ago.They shouldn't have formed so quickly.And I've never seen towers like these before.They're so short and close together.Like a beehive.It's almost like...like they're the poorest of the continent.

The elevation of the volcano is 11,616 feet.That's just under 2.2 miles.It's not exactly easy to tell what you're thinking, you know.Surely you're not taking her seriously, are you?The mountain isn't going to be easy.I have marked the dangerous areas on this map.Try to avoid them when planning your route.Before you go, let me make one thing clear.This is just my advice.Whether you take it or not is up to you.

for at least half an hour.We've still got plenty of time.Just think about it.Once the summoning are raised on,the three of us will be free.I mean, out of the school free.Out of the school?Do you even know what it's like out there?The instructor said there's a war going on.It could be dangerous.They just said that to scare us.Why are we doing it today of all days?Because it's our last good chance for the whole semester.

The march of progress.I admit it will be a revolutionary paradigm shift if it works.Of course it will.We stand on the threshold of a perfect society.The goal of my life's work and that of every Soviet scientist.Here!It's such a lively celebration.Why don't you have something to celebrate?Three sodas, please.In a little while, Dr.Satchel will begin his speech.And then, we will officially start the 2.0 big event.

Are you certain of that?It looks like he's arguing with his glove.Don't be so angry, young man.With me around, this kind of lock won't do you any harm.They can't stop me without you.Hmm...I won't deny it.但我可以直接联系双双五零,让他们把门都大开。But I can directly contact双双五零 and ask them to open the door.我都开完锁了你才告诉我。I've already locked the door, why didn't you tell me?毕竟看你落在其中嘛。After all, you're stuck in it.怎么回事?这里怎么还有小孩?

I'm floating in space with them.Isn't that great?In that moment, I stop worrying about my performance and forget all expectations.Superb!That's the best compliment I've received in months!Relax, this wasn't a test at all.We just happened to share the same taste in food.But I do hope you'll consider our offer seriously, in the spirit of the good time we had together.Are you serious though?You really mean you want me to become an astronaut?

Most people would never dare to walk on a tightrope.They pay to see people do the thrilling things that they would never do themselves.But it is a dangerous business.I often wish that you will one day find a safer way to live than this.Is it really safer to walk on Earth?How long will I live?8 years?10?15?And what then?How many years do I have left?Time never ends.It's a concept, and there are many explanations for it.

I see.How many soldiers remain aboard the train?Not many.A few were sent to guard the detention room.I think we can handle the ones that are left.Good.Everything is in place.Let's move.Wait.I hear footsteps.They saw me just then.I can't be seen here again.damn it this is getting out of hand where were we onto the next passengeryou little girl it's your turn I don't want to go come now be quiet you heard

Walking into my home with blood soaked boots.Such insolence.Does he think sending people to die makes him special?He'll pay for this in blood.That's nowhere near enough.He'll have to scrub every blood stain off the floor.I don't want to hear any excuses.This whole mess is his own fault.So he claims those big shots forced him to stain his hands, huh?How convenient.And this plan to restore everything to how it was?

Rather than simply copying nature, as artists we should strive to reveal the true ideals through our work.I'm so jealous of them.They are so talented and knowledgeable.Unlike me, I feel dizzy just seeing those guidelines.Bah!Let me show you some tricks.Better than mere linear perspective.Turns out I wasn't the only one reluctant to leave our work behindagainUccello lifted the stained glass and their story has come to a pause here.

Puedes preguntar por aquí.Tal vez algunos de nuestros miembros se conozcan de donde ella fue.¿No todos perdemos las famosas fases de nuestros viejos amigos?Estoy seguro de que van a hacer todo lo que puedan para ayudarte a encontrar a los tuyos.Mr.Idealist, terminé mi historia corta.Se llama Waitlessness.Se basa en el tema como un pez flotando en el espacio.Los lectores pueden comenzar en cualquier parte de la historia, o leerla en cualquier forma que quieran.

Representa cada segundo que pasamos aquí.Naturalmente, la llegada de nuevos miembros distrae su estructura.Y así tenemos que comenzar de nuevo desde el principio.Entonces, lo acabó todo así porque pensaba que lo íbamos a unir?Con todo respeto, esto no es un poco excesivo?Heaven knows I'm not one to judge.I've torn up plenty of writing for my novel.Please, pay it no mind.It may not be an easy task, but he's doing his part.

evidence of the body having been moved.We believe that everything occurred here.We found nothing using human investigation methods, so it must be another Arkane crime.What's the status of the Arkanum detection?Damning, there's Arkane traces all over the scene, like a ritual was held here.We tried to follow the Fluctuations trail, but they just disappeared.Our perp must have scrubbed it clean before leaving.

Today marks the 42nd day of the project.We've procured enough echo stones and the design for the dome is all but complete.Now comes the real challenge.Building the model.Looking back, this is our first real breakthrough since the project began.The structure's unstable.I'll just add another piece here for support and...beautiful.Looks like all there is left to do is put the triangular prism in place.

To the grandest, greatest, brightest tomorrow, let our sacred pyramid rise on the horizon.Something isn't right.Everyone, get...Tomorrow you sow desire.In the cemetery glowing gold, you shall die.What's going on?No more fading sunsets.No more tears that will regret.No more echoes of the past forward.Brightest tomorrow.Conclusions do seem to be right in line with their particularly mysterious field of research.

needs and safety protocols.All valid concerns, Mr.Aronai.But rest assured the investment is limited.This won't affect our broader operations.I look at this project as a kind of seed.You'll never know what it might grow into until you've put it in the ground.Isn't that so?

hidden secureMaybe with a small patch for growing corn flowerThen we'll open up a window and let some lightingListen, I'll do my best to design what you want.But remember it's only a draftDon't you go building it without talking to an engineer first.No pushing now, one at a time.Build me Irenae's office.There you are again, Plato's triangles.When joined together, you can support the entire structure above us, forgoing the

You are all late today so I don't want to hear any complaints.If I may, I'd like to adjust my report.Despite a little early friction, things seem to be on the right track now.I don't think they need any further help from me.Alright, I'm over here.Let's find those marked stalls.Not bad everyone.I'm just in time.You all must be worn out.I brought pierogi.Pierogi for dinner?I must be dreaming.I'll have ten.

There's still half an hour left.Enough time to get you out of my way!I need the core.It stays here.For Sparta!No more exaggerations or misunderstandings.When entropy reaches its minimum,a truly precise and profound form of self-expression can be reached through language.And so you will finally fully understand what I have described.If you just surrender the core, there would be no reason to fight.

why was she moved over here comrades this is your repair vendorWelcome to the repair station.This machine is a multifunctional repair device, suitable for indoor use by our staff.Other than basic repair functions, she is also able to repurpose raw materials into whatever tools you may require.Amazing.Well, let's give it a whirl.Checking an unknown object.Start analysis.This is an abnormal reaction?

You know, you haven't answered my question yet.Why do you choose to be an acrobat?Don't you find it scary to walk on a wire all the way up in the air?I suppose it is a really cool job, though.Well, it is cool, I have to admit.But what I really like about being up on the fire is that when you look down, you get tosee a view that no one else gets to in their daily life.When I stand on the fire, the audience below look just like stars, and it feels like

That place should be empty now, shouldn't it?An evacuation like this has to be for something big.Evacuations can be dangerous.A job like this shouldn't be left to new recruits.You think so?Honestly, I was hoping for a little challenge.But we're soldiers, we follow orders.Do you need a lift?Thanks, but I'm going back to check on the evacuation.Be safe.So, this is our humanitarian vacation here?An open mining pit?

Is there anything else we've missed?Anything at all?Ah, what about our special humanitarian support staff?Maybe we should give her a check too.Alright, dismissed.I'll see you at the launch bay doors in three hours.Now everyone, cool off a bit.We need to decompress before the action starts.Stay in touch via your communicators.I need everyone frosty.We're in the last mile now.There are still some things left to be checked through.

There are many, many others like me.Searching for answers from the universe.But there is no answer to be found.No answers, but the ones we choose for ourselves.Being our choice the whole time.Past is in the past, and the future will wait for us.There's no time to be spent on regrets in the moment.I must keep going.Venture further into this world to uncover what's in the distance.To know whether things that vanish come back or not.

Minds as a mirror?Ridiculous.Let me tell you.A painter's mind should be like a sheet of transparent glass.It refracts and transforms the external world, then reconstructs these images inside the painter's brain.rather than simply copying the natural world around us.Oh, hmm.That is an intriguing theory.Odd, perhaps, but not without merit.You just wait here.I'll show you with one of my recent works.

Living life to the fullest, as far as I can tell.Glad tohear it.Maybe I should envy them instead.Traveling the world like that, much better than being stuck in a policeAnd you?Don't you ever think of joining them on the hunt?My parents and I are different, to say the least.I don't share their obsession with shiny stones.A simple, comfortable life.That's all I want.No glittering ambitions, no fancy things.

Of course, it was one of those grey, overcast afternoons.I had just turned onto Calle Bolívar when I ran into this blind woman on my way to the post office.To be exact, I didn't run into her.She called to me.It felt like a sacred moment in time.Like something unworldly.But for some reason, I have this feeling you could be a character in it.Forgive me.I'm just so excited.I really want to remember this moment.

A means to explore and raise questions from different angles and express our perspectives.And what an interesting perspective you've expressed.I see.How does literature make you feel?As though I'm a kid looking through a kaleidoscope for the first time.Well, maybe that's not the best way to put it.Perhaps something a little more...subtle.Just when I was looking for the right word, she turned away with a little wave, heading

may light them like candles at our funerals.Let poetry become the bridge between us and the world.As we come back and forth over the boundaries of lifeand death, the old obstacles begin to take on a new look.With the eyes of poets, we may see behind them.You're a visceral realist.I can't be mistaken.You must be.A lonely cowboy, finally home.This is a prison.The safest place for poets in this part of the continent.

O los que están fuera de estas paredes.Hemos sido exiliados aquí por las normas de nuestro tiempo, deprimidos de nuestros roles en el mundo exterior.Pero yo vengo aquí con un objetivo diferente.Somos los últimos verdaderos propios de una antigua leyenda,palabras ahora solo recordadas como mentiras.Debemos quedarnos en el camino de la literaturahasta que encuentre esa solución transcendental.Para inventar un idioma que es genérico,

All I can say is, this unprecedented project may forever change how we think about energy usage and public safety.But recruiting from the locals, that's quite the bold move.One that I'm sure doesn't strictly comply with our confidentiality protocols.That's just the start of our worries.Training new workers under these circumstances carries dozens of other potential risks.I can't even begin to imagine how they'll understand and follow our unique construction

Still, at least they left behind something meaningful.Something worth remembering.Here, everyone pitched in to make this together.Just something made from gathered pine branches from the river and old ribbons.It's called a vieja, isn't it?Yes.It's tradition to hang it at the top of a new building to celebrate its completion.It might not be perfect, but we made sure it was clean and tidy.It's perfectly imperfect.

What's the difference?As long as there's a provka in the ballroom or two open.Nine in the morning.Right, time to go home.Another charming addition to this city.Drizzling, like that day.Or, at least, what I thought.Is the world going to end tonight?

But you can only see-We have some of the survivors of the temporal anomaly that took refuge here.They might have some idea what this place is and why it was immune.I figured there would be people living here, but I didn't expect so many.It's alright, everyone.Please, step into the light.These two ladies are the friends I mentioned earlier.They also survived that strange rain.In you no harm.You have my word.

It was the right decision to join you.Where are we?A labyrinth in a valley?Brilay believed that these were the only outskirts of the site.She said that ifwe pass through the valley, we might even find the real ruins of a temple, or a city even.Look at this stone wall.There are excavation marks on it.We ran into an abnormal whiteout last time.It was too dense.We couldn't make out any details.I've never seen this kind of rock before.

We'll shake them to see if you're a solid or a liquid.Heh, that almost made me laugh.Unfortunately for you, that is not enough to convince me to cooperate.We have a problem.Even after all this walking, I haven't gotten any closer to the Tower of Babel.If anything, it appears to be going farther and farther away.

I think it must feed on the escape plans of students like you.How else could it grow two inches taller every year?I imagine it might even serve as something of a secret hideout for them.But I wonder if anyone ever bothered to visit it again after they leave.Likely not.A once beloved place all too quickly forgotten.Do you know why?Because they are too afraid to face the difficult truth.That they wasted the most carefree days of their lives trying to escape from paradise into hell.

Only by standing on the shoulders of our forefathers have I gotten the chance to gaze upon the limitless horizons of science.Standing here now, I must thank them from the bottom of my heart.Thank you.Years ago, when my team and I invented Polymer, I had already foreseen its boundless potential.A perfect synergy of mathematics, logic, physics, chemistry, biology and other foundationalstudies in equal part, constantly pushing the frontiers of humanity's scientific exploration.

I really don't.Why should we stop?No, you're right.We shouldn't pretend as if it's normal to risk our lives for this.At the end of the day, if we die, our research dies with us.But if something were to happen to the team, you would be the one to survive.That's why I want you to keep our records, to take down everything in case the worst happens.Here, I won't take it.And I won't submit this petition for you.

What we must do then is keep ourselves safe.That way, some day in the future we will have the chance to see her again, sitting in theaudience, clapping for us until her hands are red.My big bear wants to pretend he doesn't have a heart.I know you miss her as much as I do.Of course, but I must stay in control of myself.You can't do this your whole life.Audiences come to watch an acrobat fly.But they also come to see if they will fall.

One suggests that since the whole world is made of particles,including our brains, then our minds too can be calculated,so that everything that's happening or about to happen can be predicted.Past, present, future.All that ever was and is and ever will be was destined from the moment the universe began.Each moment like a knot on a string that's already been tied.Our life's just moving along a fixed track from birth to death.

And ever so quietly, we'd dayby day become one with the world.So I wasn't afraid, didn't struggle anymore.I closed my eyes, let the smell wash over me, and a warmth grew in my heart.Let's go.We're together again.Together again.A dream.I can't remember the last time I had a good night's sleep.Huh.I must have slept longer than I thought.Nobody's around now, then I can have some fun by myself, just like the old days.

Like a lake, not red at all.How did you do that?I...I'm not a pure-blood vampire.I have to say, I didn't expect the stories of a vampire train to actually hold any truth.Though I doubt any of the stories had our vampires pouring tea in fluffing pillows.Nothing of your concern.We share a common interest, so let us treat each other as comrades.There may be tricks up my sleeve, but for now, we watch, wait, and then strike.

It's always the same story about the powerful consuming the common folk.Storytellers have always been good at making their points one way or another.Ah, that doesn't seem like the same thing to me.What do you think, ma'am?You're young.You'll grow out of these tall tales soon enough.You really don't think vampires are real?Take out the vampires, and now death is a one-way trip.The end of the line.It's way more exciting to have some twists and turns.

I mean, where's the fun in a story you can predict from the very beginning?Ah!You're in for disappointment looking at things like that.The world is filled with predictable endings, usually predictably tragic.Just look at those poor folk over there.I'm sure you're well aware already.You're confusing me, sir.Weren't we just talking about stories?The next train will arrive in 20 minutes.Please line up, taking care to bring all your belongings, and prepare your tickets for inspection.
